bounded_contexts.name: cloud-storage
bounded_contexts.description: Code-backed Cloud Storage local foundation for provider-neutral object, block, and file-storage metadata invariants plus tenant/cell object-key namespace guardrail. No live S3/OCI/Object Storage/Block Volume/File Storage service, REST server, SDK, worker, object body persistence, volume attach, filesystem mount, measured SLO, active-active DR, OpenTofu plan/apply, provider-live smoke, or audit-chain persistence is claimed by CS-CLOUD-STORAGE-001.

contracts.contract_status: root_openapi_contracts_code_tested; storage/ design AsyncAPI/proto contracts are metadata-only review evidence and do not prove runtime broker/gRPC service readiness

slo_exemption.rationale: No current measured runtime SLI exists for this foundation, retired, or local-scaffold service; the manifest must not claim production or hyperscaler-ready SLO coverage until an OpenSLO file lands.

ips.title: Tenant/cell object namespace, object retention/versioning, block snapshot evidence, file mount-policy metadata guardrail, and Cloud Storage manifest truth-down

hyperscaler_inv_coverage.circuit_breaker: not_claimed_cs_cloud_storage_001: no implemented Cloud Storage runtime circuit-breaker, bulkhead, retry, or storage gateway evidence
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.tenant_rate_limit: not_claimed_cs_cloud_storage_001: no implemented per-tenant object/block/file API quota or rate-limit enforcement
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.golden_signals: not_claimed_cs_cloud_storage_001: no implemented metrics/OpenSLO/golden-signal emission evidence
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.error_budget_burn: not_claimed_cs_cloud_storage_001: SLO list is empty because no measured Cloud Storage SLI or burn-rate rule is implemented yet

audit_chain.non_claim: CS-CLOUD-STORAGE-001 records a multispectrum evidence bundle and audit-chain row only; it does not implement Cloud Storage runtime audit emission, Merkle sealing, or persistence.

secrets_substrate.non_claim: No raw storage provider credential, access key, session token, pre-signed URL, KMS material, object body, snapshot content, or mount credential is introduced or consumed by this local foundation.

mesh_layering.non_claim: No live Cloud Storage pod, gateway, Cilium policy, service mesh policy, or network path is deployed by CS-CLOUD-STORAGE-001.

storage_namespace.non_claim: Rust guardrails validate tenant/cell namespace and evidence metadata only. They do not create buckets, enable provider object lock/versioning, write object bodies, create snapshots, attach block volumes, or mount filesystems.

data_classification: PUBLIC metadata, INTERNAL_ONLY control-plane metadata, AUDIT evidence; no tenant object body, volume content, or filesystem payload processing is implemented by this ChangeSet

capacity_model.notes: CS-CLOUD-STORAGE-001 is metadata/domain/API/adapter validation only. Runtime object I/O, block I/O, file mounts, capacity telemetry, autoscaling, and SLOs remain explicit non-claims.

sharding_automation.non_claim: No bucket shard split, volume placement rebalance, filesystem migration, tenant migration, or audit-chain persistence is implemented by CS-CLOUD-STORAGE-001.

dr.non_claim: No live Cloud Storage replication, cross-region object copy, block backup policy, file replication, warm standby, failover, restore drill, or DR measurement evidence is implemented by CS-CLOUD-STORAGE-001.

pod_runtime_tier_justification: Cloud Storage is intended Tier-1 substrate because later runtime pods will touch tenant object, block, and file data. CS-CLOUD-STORAGE-001 has no runtime pod deployment; tier is retained as intended future isolation class only.

tenant_version_pinning.non_claim: Root OpenAPI contracts are code-tested for current object/block boundary behavior, but no per-tenant API version pinning runtime is implemented by CS-CLOUD-STORAGE-001.

explicit_non_claims: No live S3, OCI Object Storage, OCI Block Volume, CSI, NFS/file-storage, SeaweedFS, MinIO, bucket creation, provider retention/versioning enablement, object body I/O, volume attach, filesystem mount, REST server, SDK, worker, OpenTofu plan/apply, provider-live smoke, measured SLO, capacity telemetry, DR, or audit-chain runtime persistence is implemented.
Legacy Markdown benchmark/parity/runbook files under storage/ remain planning/prose and are not readiness evidence for CS-CLOUD-STORAGE-001.

The root contracts/openapi/cloud/cloud-storage-*-v1.yaml files are the code-tested API evidence for this slice; storage/contracts/asyncapi and proto files are metadata-only design evidence and not runtime readiness proof.
